read.the_paired_verdict: The two sites are COMPLEMENTARY, not competing: Raleigh carries the treatment-date + confounder rigor (and returned an honest null with +12 to +15pt differentials against the corridor), Kingsport carries the fully-countable three-line dollar anatomy (construction/program/maintenance). Neither supports a causal claim; both are direction-class with named routes.

verdict: SIDE-BY-SIDE DONE. (1) The metro side: Memphis = the panel's worst-2 crime+ (132.7) on the weakest specialized-wage ceiling (3.48 ratio, p90 $100.6K) - the two named sites both attack the mechanism inside that one metro's weakest corridor (Raleigh) and its in-state small-city control-class twin (Kingsport). (2) The site side: Raleigh = dated treatment + clean confounders + honest-null differential (+14.8pts; corridor NOT improving faster than city); Kingsport = complete three-line dollars ($3.81M realized construction, $34.60-$53.91/resident program actuals, 25-29% maintenance share, lowest-murder years bracketing the 2022 opening), no counterfactual. (3) The cross-site read: program-vs-murder t0 sign negative at BOTH sites (Memphis -0.858 recomputed vs banked -0.841; Kingsport -0.767 recomputed = banked) AND negative in 4 of 5 panel cities - but lags flip positive at Kingsport and per-city n is thin; construction-dollar-per-resident is nearly identical (~$67-69) across an 11x city-size gap. Direction-class only, everywhere. The lane's discipline holds: no causal verdict, two named sites with complementary rigor, the GAP unsaturated.
